start.text: the surface runs on to the singularity $T = 0$, nearing the light cone

end.text: the surface runs on toward flat space, $T \to \infty$

views.settings: $A = 1$, the unit of every length. Every length measured with $dX^2 + dY^2 - dZ^2$.
stops: Every circle grows faster than the distance out to it, so no surface of revolution in Euclidean space has this geometry; one in Minkowski space does.
caption: The surface of $T$ and $\phi$ ($\psi = \theta = \pi/2$) of Vilenkin's instanton in Minkowski space, nearing the light cone toward the singularity $T = 0$ and level toward flat space.
